description: Source code for an Odoo report parser class 'account_balance' that generates account balance reports, including methods for processing financial data, formatting, and report generation.

classes.name: account_balance
classes.description: Parser class for account balance report, extending report_sxw.rml_parse, with methods to process account data and generate report context.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing report parser with context and setting up local context variables.

methods.name: linesForYear
methods.description: Generates a dictionary of years for report display, setting global pattern, show, perc, bal_zero, ref_bal variables.

methods.name: linesForTotal
methods.description: Calculates total debit and credit for accounts over fiscal years, updating self.result_total.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Recursively retrieves account lines with balances, formatting, and hierarchical structure for report display.

methods.name: get_years
methods.description: Returns list of fiscal years with their display names and index.

methods.name: get_lines
methods.description: Retrieves detailed account lines for a specific year, including balances and patterns.

methods.name: cal_total
methods.description: Calculates total debit and credit for a given year from self.result_total.
